finalText:
**1082 hits across 94 files.** Only about 820 are safe to rename.

| zone | hits | why not |
|---|---|---|
| repo SQL strings | 175 | real DB column names |
| `migrations/` | 61 | applied history, breaks down steps |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | generated, `vendor:refresh` overwrites it |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | frozen public contract |
| `lib/serialize.js:8` | 1 | wire name clients read |

Safe zone is JS locals, params, and object keys. The DB column needs its own migration. Do that first, or leave the SQL alone.
